methods: assigning labels (Entailment, Neutral, Contradiction) to claim-triplets

answer_4.quote: We performed human evaluation on responses generated by seven LLMs on this benchmark dataset... We annotated a total of 11k claim-triplets for 2.1k responses.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators assigned a hallucination label (Entailment, Neutral, Contradiction) to each claim-triplet or identified it as a 'bad triplet' based on comparison with references.
